headline: NetApp (NTAP) Acquires Software Firm To Deepen AI Era Data Protection
summary: NetApp (NasdaqGS: NTAP) announced the acquisition of JetStream Software to expand its data protection and cyber resilience offerings for AI workloads and VMware environments. The deal brings JetStream Software's disaster recovery, application protection, and cloud migration technology into NetApp's portfolio for enterprise clients. NetApp aims to use JetStream Software's capabilities to support customers modernizing infrastructure for AI driven applications and hybrid cloud setups. For...
